Gujarat NGO Withdraws Defamation Case Against BBC Over Modi Documentary

A Gujarat-based Non-Governmental Organization (NGO) has withdrawn a defamation lawsuit it had filed against the BBC at the Delhi High Court. The lawsuit was related to a documentary about Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The specific details of the documentary that led to the defamation claim were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage. The withdrawal of the suit means the legal challenge against the BBC concerning this matter has concluded in this court.
